status: Candidate05 guided-04 best-of-five schematic revision: seven local changes relative to coherent-01; U1/J2/J3 unchanged and saved U1 fields match the model. Source body/expected-field/page screens pass. Terminal-label planning remains blocked by Device:LED merged body-envelope cathode escape; no native glyph/flag/connectivity approval is claimed.

page.seedEvidence: Inspected current emptySchematic generator: paper A4, root sheet_instances path / page 1, empty lib_symbols. Candidate native seed was not yet created at plan time; verify actual fresh seed before applying.

decisions: All 62 references, exact library IDs, footprints, unit 1 and candidate-05 values are retained. Root approved concise engineering display values for all 62 parts; original descriptions, selected MPNs and full specifications remain in display-values.json and component/circuit records. All 62 poses are unchanged from candidate 02.

U1 is rotation 0: power top, GND bottom, USB/QSPI/clock/SWD left, GPIO right. Drawn rectangle is 43.18 x 83.82 mm before stroke; pin tips span 50.8 x 91.44 mm; DOC9 conservative corridor is 58.42 x 99.06 mm.
J2/J3 remain rotation 0 in the right column; left-facing pins retain source top-to-bottom order, with readable exact values to the right.
Vertical capacitors and most pull resistors preserve supply-above-return reading. Horizontal C3 frees the VREG_AVDD escape; USB/SWD series resistors are horizontal.
L1/L2 use 270 degrees: pin 1 left, pin 2 right. L1 reads 1V1 to CORE_LX; L2 reads RT_LX1 to RT_LX2. Their actual DOC9 fallback fields are modeled with exact values.
D2 uses 180 degrees so LED_A pin 2 and its label face left; the GND cathode faces right.
The top bank groups core/IO decoupling. Flash bypass, regulator bulk, ADC filtering and sensing remain by their functional blocks.
No optional global field-cleanup call is required. DOC9 rejects Device:L default-width arcs on that path; add_symbol catches this and retains the modeled fallback fields.
The operations list contains individual public arguments, not a driver. Read actual symbol/pin state, then let the bound host derive connectivity.

Coherent revision01 applies only the 19 root-authorized, jointly screened schematic poses in schematicRevision.moves. U1/J2/J3 are frozen. Stop after the new helper C18 ground-label blocker; no unbounded pose search performed.

Five guided local iterations completed and preserved. Publish iteration4 best geometry with seven changes from coherent01; fifth original-D2 control confirms its aggregate blocker is pose-invariant. U1/J2/J3 remained frozen throughout.
